September 14, 2000
From The Badger Herald
(MarijuanaNews note: The badger is an animal whose name has become synonymous with persistent digging, a characteristic that is also admirable in reporters, but not in evidence here. Perhaps they should change their name to The Gull.)

By Eileen Boyce

MADISON POLICE SAY THEY WILL TAKE STUDENT MARIJUANA USE SERIOUSLY

As another school year starts, so begins the thrill of the Madison party scene, which often involves the use of alcohol, marijuana and other drugs. It is a party scene, according to Madison police, that should not be taken lightly.
See
Twenty Percent Of Adults Living Within 100 miles of Madison Drink Heavily,
University of Wisconsin Study Says

While marijuana usage has continuously been a problem in Madison, marijuana-related arrests are not primarily student-related, said Lt. Bill Housley of the Dane County narcotics unit.

Despite arrests records, Housley and the Madison Police Department are still very concerned with the potential dangers marijuana and other controlled substances can bring to the UW-Madison campus area.
(MarijuanaNews note: Are the students genetically different from the other area residents? Why is it a " problem " off-campus, but not on campus? It certainly is not because the students don’t smoke. This article does not report on the point that should be of greatest concern to students.)
See
Drug Arrest Record Disclosures On Student Loans Go Into Effect

Madison police have a particular concern this academic year with a new and much higher grade of marijuana being grown in Dane County.
(MarijuanaNews note: The potent pot myth comes to Wisconsin.)
See
Potent Pot Myth Undermined By Report From The Ultimate Authority.
Cited By Swedish Prohibitionist Who Don’t Seem To Understand. As Usual.
and links

Lt. Housley said most marijuana arrests in Madison are possession arrests, but that distribution of high-grade marijuana that remains the department's biggest concern.
(MarijuanaNews note: Oh really?)
See
When Is There Mercy ? When Is There Journalism?
An Excellent Article On A Horrifying Story Ignored By The Major Media

" The current grade of marijuana is a more potent and dangerous strain than grown in the past, " Housley said.

However, many UW students do not view marijuana use as a significant problem.

" I don't feel that marijuana use is problematic on this campus, although I'm not in an environment where it is prevalent or frequently used, " said one UW junior who preferred to remain anonymous.

The more potent strain of marijuana, as with any controlled substance, introduces potentially dangerous situations and may lead to the use of more serious drugs.
(MarijuanaNews note: And now the Gateway " Theory ".)
See
 " Those who insist on keeping the plant illegal bear a serious degree of moral responsibility
for young marijuana users who do go on to use cocaine, heroin,
PCP or other genuinely dangerous or addictive drugs. "
Alan Bock, of the Orange County Register On the Real Gateway
and links

The Dane County Narcotics and Gang Task Force reported 350 drug arrests of all types between January and July. Reports have also documented homicides and sexual assaults in connection with marijuana.
(MarijuanaNews note: And now the reefer madness. Would it be too much to ask about these reports that have also " documented homicides and sexual assaults in connection with marijuana "?
Consider this from the Dane County Narcotics and Gang Task Force --
 " Wild marijuana can lead youths to get addicted to other drugs: "
The Rationale For Ditchweed Boondoggle
Is this really a credible source?)

" The level of impairment marijuana creates is its most lethal component, " said Housley..
See
UK Study Finds Marijuana Use Makes Drivers Safer. Now The Prohibitionists Can’t Hide the Study,
So They Will Just Ignore It.
and links

Many students said they do not think of marijuana as a dangerous drug.
See
Campus Magazine Survey Says Only 36% Of College Students " feel that marijuana should remain illegal. "
But they downplay the results.

" I believe most students use marijuana because it is a type of high that is different from alcohol, but not as addicting or serious as a drug like cocaine, " said another UW student who preferred to remain anonymous. " I think many students believe it is a perfect medium. "
(MarijuanaNews note: For another story with a Madison connection see
Fetal Alcohol Syndrome:
Media Reports Decry Effects Of Illegal Drugs Such As Marijuana, Cocaine And Heroin.
" They don’t have anywhere near the effect that alcohol does on the unborn baby. " )

A UW sophomore, who wished to remain anonymous, agreed that marijuana use on campus is not taken to dangerous levels.
(MarijuanaNews note: Students are afraid to disagree publicly with the party line. Doesn't that raise some concerns?)

" I think those who use marijuana on campus do not do so to a dangerous extent, " he said. " I've never really thought of it as a dangerous drug. "

Despite this belief, many health agencies and the MPD report many serious drug habits begin with marijuana use.
(MarijuanaNews note: From the IOM report: " (I)t is the legal status of marijuana that makes it a gateway drug. " Is that a sufficiently credible source?)

Although UW students and Madison police officers do not share the same views on the problem of marijuana, Madison police hope students realize the potential hazards of not only marijuana, but also of alcohol and other drugs throughout the school year.
(MarijuanaNews note: Why should the students believe anything that the Madison police say, or that the Badger prints? If the Badger really wants to do some reporting on marijuana and the law they should see
How The War On Marijuana Really Works:
Great Journalism That Should Serve As A Template For Local Publications Around The Country. )

and

DA Is On The Spot.
" Tax dollars and lives are being wasted on a fool’s mission that
sensible Madisonians thought they had ended more than two decades ago. "
